messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 ALERT — Router p99 > 1.5s (SLO=1.0s) across us-west-2. Streaming stalls up x4. Auto-pager to #oncall and #incidents. Link: https://metrics.redwood/alert/2361

andy: I got the page. what scope are we looking at? p95/p99 numbers? any known rollout?

metrics-bot: Current snapshot: p95=340ms (baseline ~200ms), p99=1.72s. Streaming stall rate = 4.1x baseline. Top affected route: POST /v1/chat/generate (us-west-2). Top model variant by error volume: r3-large-q8 (hot shard concentration).

sumir: looking at router logs — we pushed routing-policy v2 at 23:10 UTC yesterday which adjusted shard weights. There is a clear weight skew: shard 77 and 128 got 3x more traffic than expected.

raj: confirm — policy rollout started at 2026-03-14T23:10Z to 20% traffic. autoscale looked fine but hot partitioning appeared due to hash seed change.

jen: ok action list quick: 1) pause routing-policy rollout 2) revert to previous seed/config for router 3) apply eager fallback to r3-medium for long-stream requests 4) start manual rebalance for hot shard 77. I'll coordinate.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: routing-policy rp-v2 -> rp-v1. job id: jb-98321.

elena: CS: we have 3 customers pinging support (Acme Inc, BigRetail, FinCo). Maya, can you confirm impact and whether to notify SAs?

maya: pinged SAs. Acme sees stream stalls and partial responses for ~20 minutes. I'm preparing a short customer bulletin.

andy: commands to run if others need to take over:
```
# pause rollout
redwoodctl routing pause --policy rp-v2
# rollback
redwoodctl routing rollback --policy rp-v2 --to-revision rp-v1
# set per-route weight (temporary)
redwoodctl route weight set --route /v1/chat/generate --shard 77 --weight 0.05
```
I'll run the pause now.

sumir: another mitigation possibility: enable per-route KV-cache bypass for long-streams to reduce tail queuing. It's slightly risky (cache miss cost) but reduces stall amplification. Recommend fallback first.

jen: pause executed at 2361235000. rollback started by deploy-bot (jb-98321). enabling graceful fallback to r3-medium for streaming sessions for affected routes now.

deploy-bot: rollback in progress across USW2 nodes (region chunk 1/3).

metrics-bot: t+3m after rollback start: p95=290ms, p99=1.05s. streaming-stall rate down to 1.6x. improvement but tail still slightly above SLO.

raj: there is residual hot partition on shard 77 — kernel shows queued requests backlog. I'm initiating manual shard rebalance. ETA ~ 8 minutes.

sumir: I'm also enabling per-route circuit-breaker for long-running streams (max_concurrent_streams=4) for customers hitting repeated stalls. This will shed load and prevent head-of-line.

andy: applied `max_concurrent_streams=4` to top 10 offender orgs.

elena: quick ask — what's estimated customer impact so we can prioritize outreach?

sumir: rough numbers: affected requests ~0.8% of total qps, but they constitute ~12% of p99 breaches due to amplification. That maps to ~3 customers seeing degraded streaming UX.

maya: outbound msg sent to Acme + BigRetail: "We're investigating higher latency/streaming interruptions; mitigations are in progress. We'll follow up in 30m."

deploy-bot: rollback completed: USW2/USE1/EUW1. job jb-98321 -> SUCCESS at 2361235600.

metrics-bot: t+12m from mitigation: p95=260ms, p99=0.93s, streaming-stall rate back to baseline.

andy: good — tail back under SLO. I am handing off to Raj for follow-up rebalancing and postmortem. Leaving oncall now.

raj: copying followups: 1) full shard rebalance for 77 (in progress) 2) investigate hashing/seed drift in rollout pipeline 3) add extra telemetry on per-shard qlen and request skew 4) postmortem owner: jen.

jen: will own the postmortem. timeline notes: rollout -> skew -> hot shard -> p99 spike -> rollback + fallback -> throttle -> rebalance. Postmortem will include detection gaps and remediation (automatic rollback thresholds, per-shard heatmap, canary QPS limits).

metrics-bot: incident state -> mitigated (monitoring).

maria: (typo) sorry — thanks team :thumbsup:   

andy: nice work everyone. I'll add a short summary to #incidents and schedule a 30m follow-up sync.

jen: adding immediate TODOs in ticket tracker and flagging model-variant routing for a safety limit.

maya: will follow up with customers when we have the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident 2361234567: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared.
